title: Rules of behaviour need documented acknowledgement before access
remediation: The sponsor user governance and privacy leads approve roles and expected behaviour for using the system and protecting specified information. Provide current rules to individuals requiring access and verify a dated acknowledgement of agreement before granting access. Record assigned review and update cadence. Use de-identified or restricted evidence.

milestones.title: Collect approved rules, distribution and review records, and redacted acknowledgement and subsequent access grant timestamps
